basic_info.description: Welcome to 785 Andover in the vibrant Bernal Heights neighborhood. This charming semi-detached single-family home, built in 1992, offers amazing comfort with 2 levels of living space.  The main floor features a vaulted ceiling, spacious living room, open dining area that leads into a quaint kitchen with Bayview style windows.  An elevated deck overlooks a serene center courtyard.  The bedrooms offer delightful views with updated windows.   Each of the 3 bedrooms are adorned with windows that invite natural light and sizable closet space for storage.  New flooring, new kitchen appliances and updates around all add to this welcoming home.  Enjoy great savings on energy costs with the solar panels and new efficient heat pump  water heater.  Located a short distance from 280 and 101, and MUNI, this home offers easy access to Bernal Heights' well known cafe's and restaurants, Alemany Farmers Market and St. Mary's Park Don't miss the opportunity to make this elegant and inviting residence your own!
